name: textui-workspace
description: Workspace root for TextUI - a graph-mounted terminal UI runtime

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/widgets packages/terminal packages/facade packages/documents packages/testing packages/cli packages/textide packages/textide-git
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/*/*.tsbuildinfo playground/.dev examples/*/.dev packages/textide/.dev
scripts.docs:check: node scripts/docs/extract-props.mjs && node scripts/docs/gen-components.mjs --check && node scripts/docs/check-links.mjs && node scripts/check-docs.mjs
